image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: educational salon assessment image for a mobile hair-aesthetics training case
Primary request: Create one horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the SAME fictional adult East Asian woman in her CURRENT hairstyle only: front view, true right profile, true left profile, and back view. This is not a makeover and not a proposed result.
Scene/backdrop: neutral warm-gray salon studio backdrop, no salon branding or props.
Subject: one fictional adult woman, consistent identity, face proportions, skin tone, clothing, hair color, and hairstyle across all four panels. Current hair is dark brown, mostly straight and smooth at the upper surface, medium-long with the baseline about 5 cm below the collarbone, subtle irregular natural bends in the inner lower layers, slightly dry-looking uneven ends and a few softly lighter face-framing strands from old color. Hair is worn down in every panel. Calm neutral expression in the front panel. Simple matte charcoal wide-neck top so the full neck and both shoulders remain clearly visible.
Style/medium: natural documentary salon photography, realistic skin pores and individual hair fibers, no beauty retouching, no glamour styling.
Composition/framing: four equal vertical panels in one landscape image; each panel shows the complete head, full hairstyle baseline, neck, and both shoulders; consistent camera height, lens, distance, lighting, and scale. Front must be truly frontal; side panels must be true 90-degree profiles; back must be directly from behind. No cropping of crown, hair ends, neck, or shoulders.
Lighting/mood: soft even neutral daylight, enough separation to read the outer silhouette and surface texture, no dramatic highlights.
Constraints: current-state documentation only; keep the same person and exact current hairstyle across all panels; no perm curls, no redesign, no after photo, no cutting guides, no labels, no text, no watermark. The apparent dryness is only visual and must not imply a diagnosed damage grade.
Avoid: split identities, three-quarter views, mirrored duplicate side views, beautification, exaggerated frizz, wet hair, hair extensions, accessories, hands, tools, logos, measurement marks, before/after claims.
